Class IamClient

java.lang.Object
com.chaosguide.iam.vertex.client.IamClient
public class IamClient extends Object
IAM Server HTTP 客户端。

职责只覆盖 SDK 需要的三个协议边界：

  • /open/v1/permissions:resolve：运行时根据角色解析权限。
  • /open/v1/apps/{clientId}/permissions：Gradle/codegen 拉取权限快照。

clientId 是 ApplicationClient.clientId。权限快照和权限上传属于服务端管理调用， 必须使用 WEB/M2M confidential ApplicationClient，并配置对应 clientSecret。

    • getMe

      public UserProfileResponse getMe(String accessToken)
      Fetches the current user's latest profile via GET /api/v1/auth/me/profile.

      This call uses the user's bearer token, not the SDK client secret. It is intended for explicit profile reads and should not be called automatically during every authorization check. Its optional metadata field is profile metadata, not app-scoped authorization attributes.
